# TruckMate Mobile Communications API (ART; mobile-communications provider interface)

- **Product:** TruckMate Mobile Communications API (ART; mobile-communications provider interface) (Transportation family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** TruckMate API key (bearer) or Trimble ID JWT. Declared security schemes: tidJwtAuth, truckmateApiKeyAuth.
- **Access:** Mobile-communications (in-cab device) providers integrated with TruckMate.
- **To call it you would need:** provider credentials and the customer's TruckMate ART host; every write is safety-excluded because it would inject device data.
- **Documented servers:** none in the definition.
- **Definition:** [truckmate-mobcomm](https://truckmatecloudhub.trimble-transportation.com/mobcomm/openapi.json) (Mobile Communications API, version 1). Documentation: https://learn.transportation.trimble.com/wp-content/uploads/tte/am9cye79c1s4oy65d35c/docs/TruckMate2026.1-ReleaseNotes_72386d_rn.pdf.
